label: autophagy
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell degrades intracellular material, including its own constituents or intracellular non-self cargo, by delivering that material to lysosomal or vacuolar compartments.
observations: Corrected nuclear-cargo scope (#1754); supersedes v514-v518 parent wording.

label: proteaphagy
definition: An autophagy phenotype in which a microbial cell degrades its proteasomes or proteasome subcomplexes by delivering them to lysosomal or vacuolar compartments.
observations: Proteasomes are cargo, including subcomplexes; retain route and correction limits.
